items.title_zh: “没人想要了”：隐孢子虫吓退消费者，生菜价格创纪录暴跌
items.summary: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.
items.summary_zh: 在隐孢子虫疫情下，就餐者重新审视这种蔬菜，生菜价格录得有记录以来最大环比跌幅。
